svg.title: The Status screen, page by page
svg.desc: The Status screen in Xian, one step at a time. First the member row: the hand picks Isaac from the party at the top, and his summary fills the window below, with the four Djinn figures, one for each element, standing in it. A opens his status page: his Djinn, Power and Resist for each element, the Djinn figures now a little higher. A again opens his Psynergy page: Cure, Cure Well, Move, Quake and Earthquake, each with its PP cost. A again opens his equipment page: Broad Sword, Bronze Helm, Bronze Shield and Adept's Clothes; on these last two pages the Djinn figures are moved off the top of the screen. A on the equipment page goes back round to the status page, B on any page goes back to the member row, and L and R switch to another member.
svg.text: ISAAC ON THE STATUS SCREEN, IN XIAN
A here goes back to the status page; B on
any page, to the member row. L and R switch.
